senses.sense_definition: An amateur who dabbles in a field out of casual interest rather than as a profession.

examples.text: He is a mere <w>dilettante</w> who never commits to finishing any of his artistic projects.
The critic dismissed the painter as a <w>dilettante</w> lacking the discipline of a true professional.

senses.sense_definition: A person with a general but superficial interest in art or a branch of knowledge.

examples.text: She is a <w>dilettante</w> who reads a few pages of philosophy but never studies the subject deeply.
The lecture was too complex for the <w>dilettante</w> who only had a passing interest in the topic.

senses.sense_definition: Pertaining to or characteristic of a person who dabbles in a field without serious commitment.

examples.text: His <w>dilettante</w> approach to science prevented him from making any significant discoveries.
The project suffered from a <w>dilettante</w> attitude that ignored the necessary technical requirements.
